title: Disabling cellular watch's connection
symptom: The Wear OS service disables cellular connection on the watch when battery is 15% or less, and the watch may enter a deep sleep mode after 30-60 minutes of inactivity when not connected via Bluetooth to the phone, causing loss of cellular data connectivity and preventing transmission of readings from the watch collector to the phone.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause; it suggests that Wear OS services or battery saver features may cause the deep sleep mode and loss of cellular connectivity, but this is speculative.
fix: No resolution is provided in the thread. The user asks for a workaround, but no solution is confirmed.
evidence_quote: Nevertheless sometimes my watch goes into something like a "deep sleep mode" and loses cellular data connectivity.
